subject: Managing multiple development versions of R

messages.author: a79eb65f0eae8655
messages.subject: Managing multiple development versions of R
parts:
Hi Group,

I've submitted my package to CRAN, but it's failing with a number of warnings that are (I think) unique to R 2.14.2, which is in beta.

I'm running R 2.14.1 (the latest stable release), so I can't generate the errors CRAN is seeing on my end. Does anyone have good advice for installing and managing multiple versions of R. I've never had to do this before.

- Brian

messages.author: 065110cca96a6373
messages.subject: Re: Managing multiple development versions of R
parts:
Hi Brian,

I usually run the latest stable and compile R-devel from source. It
is really easy---just keep them in separate directories. If you want
to build/check your package against one or the other, just cd over to
the bin of the version of R you want and R CMD build it.

I do not have the beta, but if you want a check against R-devel, I can
source and try building your package.

Cheers,

Josh
